label: MEET IDREADY
title:
Your photo.
Print ready.
subtitle: A simpler way to prepare ID photos.
narration: Meet ID Ready. A simple way to turn your photo into an ID picture, or a sheet ready to print.

label: 01 / ADD YOUR PHOTO
title:
Start with
a photo.
subtitle: Camera capture or JPEG, PNG and WebP.
narration: Take a photo with your camera, or upload one from your device. Keep your head and shoulders visible, with even lighting.

label: 02 / MAKE IT YOURS
title:
A clean look.
Your control.
subtitle: Local background removal. Precise framing.
narration: Remove the background on your device. Adjust the crop, zoom, and lighting. Add an optional border or digital name tag.

label: 03 / EXPORT AND PRINT
title:
One photo.
Or a whole sheet.
subtitle: Physical-size PDF. PNG and JPEG downloads.
narration: Choose your photo size, paper, and copy count. Download a PDF, then print at actual size, one hundred percent, with fit to page turned off.

label: READY WHEN YOU ARE
title:
Download once.
Work offline.
subtitle: Complete offline setup on each device.
narration: For offline use, open the app online and download the required assets. After setup, your photos stay on your device, with no account needed.

label: IDREADY
title:
Less hassle.
Ready to print.
subtitle: Take. Edit. Export.
narration: ID Ready. Your photo, print ready. Follow the receiving agency's requirements. A digital name tag does not replace a required physical name tag.
